Plot dissimilarities between the samples of each subject

Source: R/AllGenerics.R, R/plotRecurrence.R, R/zzz-mae.R
plotRecurrence.Rd

plotRecurrence() draws, for each subject, a time by time matrix of the dissimilarities between its samples. With threshold, it draws a recurrence plot: the pairs of samples closer than the threshold.

Usage

plotRecurrence(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SummarizedExperiment'
plotRecurrence(
  x,
  dissimilarity,
  time.col,
  group,
  subjects = NULL,
  threshold = NULL,
  ...
)

# S4 method for class 'MultiAssayExperiment'
plotRecurrence(x, ..., experiment = 1L)

Arguments

x

a SummarizedExperiment object.

...

additional arguments passed to geom_rect.

dissimilarity

Character scalar. Specifies the sample by sample dissimilarity in metadata(x), as stored by mia::addDissimilarity().

time.col

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) that contains sampling times: numeric, Date, POSIXct or a factor of visits.

group

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) that identifies subjects.

subjects

Character vector. Subjects to draw, one panel each. If NULL, draws all. (Default: NULL)

threshold

Numeric scalar. Marks the pairs of samples with a dissimilarity of at most this. If NULL, colours by dissimilarity. (Default: NULL)

experiment

Character scalar or integer scalar. For a MultiAssayExperiment, the experiment to plot; its samples get the colData of x. (Default: 1L)

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Each sample covers the time from halfway to its previous sample to halfway to its next one, so the axes keep the spacing of the sampling times. Visits are evenly spaced.

Examples

# Three bioreactors under the same perturbations
data("minimalgut", package = "miaTime")
tse <- mia::addDissimilarity(minimalgut, method = "bray",
    assay.type = "counts")
plotRecurrence(tse, dissimilarity = "bray", time.col = "Time.hr",
    group = "StudyIdentifier")


# Pairs of samples within a Bray-Curtis dissimilarity of 0.2
plotRecurrence(tse, dissimilarity = "bray", time.col = "Time.hr",
    group = "StudyIdentifier", subjects = "Bioreactor A",
    threshold = 0.2)
